node.title: AQB-I averaged quotient-box estimate
node.statement: AQB-I (Pro Brief I, verified constants): an averaged family over the c=2 quotient geometry gaining >= 429,645,547 total bits (= 0.000390760348 bits per 2^40 fiber coordinates) over the single-word floor at sigma* = 8,592,912,738. Exact deficit B_I = d*256 - 40 - log2 C(2^40, 2^39+d), d = 4,296,456,369; worst case at Q=256, monotone in Q. Cross-validation: the unamplified row's Qcrit = 255.90000002 reproduces the Modal q-threshold independently.
node.notes: AQB ROUTE REFUTED (Pro, verified): convex-combination obstruction — the averaging transfer needs the family AVERAGE (convex comb of single-box counts <= max box), so box-sharing saves log|F| but the ÷|F| normalization cancels it. Gain needs a heavy-fiber theorem (forbidden, circular). See aqb_coupled_family_entropy_manifest_payload/refutation.md.
